title: Leveraging Psychophysical Attentional Distribution for Gaze-Augmented Reward Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2611.13477v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Integrating human feedback into language models has gained increasing attention as a means to align model outputs with human preferences, with Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) serving as a prominent framework for preference-based alignment. Recent studies have incorporated eye-tracking (ET) data as an additional supervisory signal for reward model training, grounding reward learning in human reading behavior. Building on this approach, we extend prior fixation-centric models by leveraging established findings from cognitive psychology on human letter recognition. Specifically, we model visual attention as a spatially graded distribution centered on the current gaze location and incorporate this representation into reward model training. translated_title: 利用心理物理学注意力分布进行注视增强的奖励建模
translated_abstract: 将人类反馈整合到语言模型中作为使模型输出与人类偏好对齐的手段，正受到越来越多的关注，其中基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）是基于偏好的对齐的重要框架。最近的研究将眼动追踪（ET）数据作为奖励模型训练的额外监督信号，将奖励学习建立在人类阅读行为的基础上。在这一方法的基础上，我们利用认知心理学中关于人类字母识别的既有发现，对以往以注视为中心的模型进行了扩展。具体而言，我们将视觉注意力建模为以当前注视位置为中心的空间梯度分布，并将这一表示融入奖励模型训练中。我们的结果表明，使用所提出的注视分布训练的奖励模型比基线模型取得了更高的偏好预测准确率。此外，我们的一些结果……
tldr: 该论文基于认知心理学中人类字母识别的发现，将视觉注意力建模为以注视点为中心的空间梯度分布并融入RLHF奖励模型训练，从而实现了比基线更高的偏好预测准确率。
en_tdlr: This paper leverages cognitive psychology findings on human letter recognition to model visual attention as a spatially graded distribution centered on the gaze location, incorporating it into RLHF reward model training to achieve higher preference prediction accuracy than the baseline.
